description: Pattern-level composition recipes for agents — useWhen/avoidWhen without replacing pattern chrome.

patterns.name: CTASection
useWhen: marketing call-to-action band at section end
primary and secondary actions with title and description
inverse or primary background CTA block
avoidWhen: inline alert or toast feedback
header navigation or language switcher
replacing shadcn CTA buttons with @dt/Button without variant parity review

variantNotes.inverseBackground: Production CTASection uses @/components/ui/button outline on dark bands — do not swap to @dt/Button tertiary without contrast check.

patterns.name: Header
useWhen: legacy site header with nav items and language switcher
avoidWhen: Next.js app shell — prefer SiteHeader in app routes
mass-replacing native header buttons with @dt/Button without design sign-off

variantNotes.chrome: Keep native <button> for language/theme controls unless explicitly redesigning header chrome.

patterns.name: HeroSection
useWhen: full-bleed marketing hero with alignment and background variants
homepage or landing hero shell with min-height
avoidWhen: blog article hero — prefer ArticleHero pattern
compact inline page title without hero imagery
production homepage with kinetic title — prefer HomeHero

variantNotes.background: Supports backgroundImage and tokenized min-height; compose children rather than hardcoding layout.

patterns.name: HomeHero
useWhen: production homepage hero with kinetic title and scroll indicator
full-bleed homepage hero on dark or gradient background bands
homepage hero with @dt/Button primary CTA on inverse surface
avoidWhen: generic marketing hero without homepage-specific motion
blog article hero — prefer ArticleHero
swapping outline shadcn buttons to @dt/Button tertiary on dark bands without contrast check

variantNotes.inverseBackground: Uses @dt/Button with surface=default on dark HeroBackground — do not use isInverse primary over gradient parents.
variantNotes.motion: KineticTitle and TextReveal require reduced-motion fallbacks — do not strip animation hooks.

patterns.name: SiteHeader
useWhen: Next.js app shell sticky header with brand and nav
production site header with theme and language controls
global navigation shell on marketing routes
avoidWhen: Storybook-only legacy Header pattern
embedded header inside a card or modal
replacing native header buttons without design sign-off

variantNotes.chrome: Production SiteHeader owns theme/language controls — do not swap to @dt/Button without explicit header redesign.

patterns.name: SiteFooter
useWhen: site-wide footer with link columns and social links
global footer shell on marketing routes
avoidWhen: legacy Footer pattern with different IA
inline footer inside a card or modal
admin or app-specific footer fork

variantNotes.singleton: Mount exactly one SiteFooter per page via app layout.

patterns.name: NewsBulletin
useWhen: homepage news strip with three topical slots above footer
footer-adjacent bulletin cards with internal or external links
avoidWhen: full blog index or article grid
alert or toast feedback surfaces
inline card stack without region landmark

variantNotes.data: Items default from NEWS_BULLETIN_ITEMS — keep copy in the data module for i18n.

patterns.name: ArticleHero
useWhen: blog article hero with title metadata and optional image
avoidWhen: marketing homepage hero — prefer HeroSection
compact page title without article metadata

variantNotes.metadata: Expects article fields (date, author, tags) — compose rather than hardcoding.
